source_text.ISS-0348: ISSUE-FIXER's diagnosis (handoffs/WF03-ISS0348-20260826/step-01-issue-fixer.json result): Backfill.run/1 does an unscoped Repo.all(Registration) whole-table scan (by design -- a backfill tool must see every provisioned tenant). Under full serial test runs, other async:false tests that flip Sandbox mode to :auto (per pre-existing OPEN issue ISS-0113 -- Sandbox.mode/2 is repo-global, not per-test, and provisioned_tenant!/1 never restores :manual) can leave real committed tenant/Registration rows visible to BackfillTest's assertions, causing its exact-count assertions to see extra rows it didn't create.

task.description: CODE-DESIGNER (WF-03 Step 2, fix design) for ISS-0348. Design a fix SCOPED TO test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill_test.exs's own assertions. DO NOT design a fix touching the shared TenantFixture/Sandbox global mode mechanism (test/support/tenant_fixture.ex, test/support/data_case.ex) -- ISS-0113 already investigated and REVERTED exactly that class of fix after it broke 12 other tests across 3 distinct mechanisms (identity_test.exs double-checkout collision, engine/reconstruction_test.exs concurrent-connection tests, promotion_assertion_rerun_test.exs's second-provisioning-in-same-test pattern). Read ISS-0113.yaml's investigation_note in full before designing -- do not re-propose that same shape.
acceptance_criteria: Backfill.run/1's own production code (lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill.ex) is NOT changed -- its unscoped whole-table scan is correct/intentional production behavior for a backfill tool, not the defect

Design shows how backfill_test.exs's assertions become resilient to pre-existing/leaked Registration or tenant rows from other tests -- e.g. by scoping each test's post-run assertions to only the tenant_id(s) that specific test created, rather than asserting exact global {updated, skipped} totals that assume zero background rows
Design does not touch test/support/tenant_fixture.ex, test/support/data_case.ex, or any Sandbox.mode call -- confirm this explicitly as a design constraint satisfied
Design states the specific assertion changes per failing test case (the 4 named in docs/issues/ISS-0348.yaml)
No implementation code -- signatures/assertion-shape descriptions only

result.summary: Design produced at lib/letflow/design/iss0348-backfill-test-isolation.md. Core approach: replace each of the 4 failing tests' exact-match assertions on Backfill.run/1's global {updated, skipped} tally with bound assertions (updated >= N / skipped >= M, derived from that test's own known tenant contribution) instead of exact literals, relying on the proven monotonicity property that leaked rows can only add to the aggregate counters, never invert a specific tenant's outcome. Each test's existing per-tenant Registry.get_type/2 pre/post checks (already scoped to that test's own tenant_id) remain the authoritative regression proof and are unchanged; test 2 (ISS-0343 vanished-schema) gets one added standalone, side-effect-free Registry.register_type/2 call scoped to vanished_tenant_id to strengthen (not weaken) its 'was skipped, not just present' claim. Backfill.run/1 (lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill.ex) is untouched. test/support/tenant_fixture.ex, test/support/data_case.ex, and all Sandbox.mode calls are untouched -- explicitly confirmed not to re-propose ISS-0113's reverted global-restore fix shape.
